hero.title: Every reusable element, in one place.
hero.lede: Two kinds of code exist here: a reusable element, or configuration composing one. This page is the inventory of the first kind — types, components, widgets, libraries and modules — so a change reaches for what already exists before it writes something new.

docsAbstractions.intro: The web-ui and native-C halves below are curated by hand, because typedoc reads TSDoc, not Vue single-file components or C headers. The {'@'}openmixer/core and {'@'}openmixer/server halves are generated straight from their TSDoc comments — {generated} exported symbols, {documented} of them with a summary.
